name: Dasoor
description: Dasoor was a planet located in the Dasoor system in the Agarix sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was known as a world overrun by thieves, and gangs of enslavers. Some months after the Battle of Endor, the smuggler Han Solo and his Wookiee co-pilot Chewbacca were headed to this planet, before changing course to the Wookiee's home planet of Kashyyyk.
